name: codex-harnessdock
description: HarnessDock for Codex is an unofficial third-party checkout-owned multi-Harness Agent runtime for Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi with durable roots, completion delivery, native history, interruption, and exact-session follow-up where supported; it is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

interface.shortDescription: Experimental durable multi-Harness Agents for Codex
interface.longDescription: Experimentally run Claude Code, OpenCode, and Pi through one checkout-owned Agent runtime with explicit routes, durable messages, bounded progress, complete completion delivery, fixed Agent-turn joins and all-settled barriers, native history, interruption, and exact-session continuation where supported.
defaultPrompt: Use $codex-harnessdock:spawn-agent with mcp__codex_harnessdock__spawn_agent to create an Experimental named HarnessDock Agent asynchronously on one explicit Harness route
Use $codex-harnessdock:followup-task with mcp__codex_harnessdock__followup_task to continue a HarnessDock Agent when its route supports continuation
Use $codex-harnessdock:list-agents with mcp__codex_harnessdock__list_agents to inspect local HarnessDock Agent work
Use $codex-harnessdock:wait-agent with mcp__codex_harnessdock__wait_agent for one exact Agent turn or a fixed all-settled barrier when the dependency set is known
Use $codex-harnessdock:read-agent-messages with mcp__codex_harnessdock__read_agent_messages to retrieve earlier native assistant messages without activating the Agent when its route supports history
